meta.disclaimer: Fictional, company-themed interview simulations inspired by broad industry expectations. Not official company assessments and not affiliated with or endorsed by any company named.
meta.syllabus_source: IntelliBI Python for Data Engineering, 2026 Edition, Modules 1-12

coding_rubric.notes: Tests run the student's code with the given stdin and compare stdout after trimming trailing whitespace on each line. Marks depend only on the number of tests passed, never on the source text.

meta.mcq_notes: answer is the zero-based index of the correct option in the original order. The HTML app shuffles option order at runtime and maps the correct answer back by option text.

coding.statement: Read comma-separated transaction amounts and print their total with exactly two decimal places.

coding.title: Character Frequency
coding.statement: Read a string and print each distinct character (ignoring spaces) with its count, in order of first appearance. Format: character, a space, count, one line each.

coding.output_description: One line per distinct non-space character: the character, a space, and its count.

l 2

coding.output_description: One line per key in alphabetical order: key and total.
